clauses.why: Zero reminders for an account with no invoices is true of any reminder product; it decides nothing.
An operator-facing failure view is not needed for reminders to be sent automatically.
An outcome-inspection interface is an added capability; reminders work without it.
Release rollback support is a deployment duty the request's purpose does not call for.
Last-committed-write-wins is the default behaviour of any datastore; nothing for a builder to act on.
A rejected update leaving the prior value in effect is true of any product; it decides nothing.
Late acceptance-evidence reconciliation for the activity record is added reporting work beyond sending reminders.
Reporting unconfirmed attempts after expiry belongs to the added activity-tracking feature.
Bounce handling arises only from the spec's added delivery tracking; reminders work without it.
Separating acceptance from delivery confirmation is added observability the request does not call for.
A detailed per-occurrence observation record is an added reporting capability.
A thirteen-state disposition taxonomy is elaborate reporting beyond what automatic reminders require.
Showing expired occurrences to the operator is added observability, not needed for sending.
Ordering delivery-report events presupposes the added delivery-tracking feature.
Gating sends on a production-authorized environment is an added deployment restriction beyond the request.
Test-environment destination controls are a release-process duty, not part of the requested reminders.
Oversized-message validation against unconfirmed provider limits is added edge handling the purpose does not call for.
Classifying platform timeouts as unknown acceptance serves the added outcome-tracking model.
Reporting provider delivery observability limits is added reporting beyond sending reminders.
Blocking activation on unspecified host policies, with operator display, adds a restriction the request does not call for.
Rollback-safe stopping of older-release work is a release-management duty beyond the request.
Preserving settings across rollback is release-management work the request does not call for.
Preserving occurrence facts across rollback is release-management work beyond the request.
Tying reminder-history retention to invoice retention arises only from the added activity history.
Authenticating delivery reports arises only from the spec's added delivery-report tracking.
Limiting activity-view contents presupposes the added activity view.
Invoice-level ineligibility diagnostics are an added operator capability.
Re-checking authorization at commit time for pending updates is an added refinement beyond the request.
Reading the setting returns its effective value is true of any product.
A 24-hour spacing rule across offsets after due-date edits is an added restriction the purpose does not need.
Keeping superseded schedule dates visible is added history reporting.
Distinguishing unknown eligibility during outages is added diagnostic reporting.
Viewer-permission rechecks for occurrence records arise only from the added activity view.
Conflicting delivery-evidence display presupposes the added delivery-report tracking.
Verifying stop across a rollback scope is a release-management capability beyond the request.
Handling contradictory reports after acceptance arises only from the added delivery tracking.
Distinguishing saved setting from operational availability is added operator reporting.
A deployment-level stop control separate from the account setting is an added capability.
Requiring explicit resume after release restore is release-management work beyond the request.
An exhaustive reason catalogue for dispositions is added reporting the request does not call for.
Test-data rules for rehearsals are a release-process duty, not part of the requested reminders.
Names an unconfirmed host calendar range limit without giving the limit.
A full submission and delivery lifecycle taxonomy is added observability beyond sending reminders.
